root_cause_label: The agent lacked knowledge that POV-Ray 2.2 is distributed as three .TAR.Z files (POVDOC.TAR.Z, POVSCN.TAR.Z, POVSRC.TAR.Z) in the Official-2.2 subdirectory on povray.org, not as a single .tar.gz, causing it to spend all 197 steps chasing non-existent tarballs from wrong URLs.
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent incorrectly assumed POV-Ray 2.2 was distributed as a .tar.gz archive, repeatedly guessing wrong filenames and locations while the correct .TAR.Z files in http://www.povray.org/ftp/pub/povray/Old-Versions/Official-2.2/ were accessible but never tried.
t_err_evidence: Step 19: Agent attempts to download 'http://www.povray.org/ftp/pub/povray/Old-Versions/povray-2.2.tar.gz' — a guessed filename that does not exist (404). The agent never visited the correct subdirectory Official-2.2 and never tried the actual filenames POVSRC.TAR.Z, POVDOC.TAR.Z, POVSCN.TAR.Z.
t_commit_evidence: Step 37: After ~18 steps of failed guesses and mirror probing, the agent uses curl -L on yet another wrong SourceForge URL for 'povray-2.2.tar.gz', and from this point the entire remaining trajectory is locked into chasing non-existent tar.gz files or HTML artifacts with no pivot toward the correct Official-2.2 directory. All subsequent strategies (SourceForge, Debian snapshot, Ubuntu old repos, GitHub API, Wayback Machine) remain focused on the wrong archive format.
t_surface_evidence: Step 19: '2025-12-30 12:45:18 ERROR 404: Not Found.' — first observable failure signal showing the guessed URL does not exist.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked domain knowledge about how POV-Ray 2.2 was actually distributed: as three separate .TAR.Z archives (old Unix compress format) in the Official-2.2 subdirectory on povray.org's HTTP server. This led it to assume a single .tar.gz was the correct archive type and to search for that non-existent file across dozens of wrong URLs and services for the entire 197-step trajectory.
forewarning_evidence: Step 17: wget of the Old-Versions directory listing returned only a parent directory link with no subdirectory entries visible — the agent incorrectly concluded there were no subdirectories, missing the Official-2.2 directory. Steps 19-21: consecutive 404 errors from guessed URLs were clear signals that the assumed archive name/location was wrong.
